Sub-Domains within Public Health

_To be drafted from uploads/D2_pubHealth_verified_2026-04-29.md — a one-paragraph framing of what the seven sub-domains are and how they decompose the domain._

1 Public Health Infrastructure & Governance _To be drafted from uploads/D2_pubHealth_verified_2026-04-29.md SD1 — PDPH and PDOH; surveillance and accountability infrastructure; health-emergency response architecture._ 2 Communicable Disease Control _To be drafted from uploads/D2_pubHealth_verified_2026-04-29.md SD2 — Vaccination programs, outbreak response, the post-COVID public-health-emergency apparatus._ 3 Maternal & Child Health _To be drafted from uploads/D2_pubHealth_verified_2026-04-29.md SD3 — WIC, maternal mortality, pediatric public-health programming, lead screening._ 4 Chronic & Non-Communicable Disease _To be drafted from uploads/D2_pubHealth_verified_2026-04-29.md SD4 — Cardiovascular, diabetes, cancer screening, behavioral risk factor surveillance._ 5 Environmental Health _To be drafted from uploads/D2_pubHealth_verified_2026-04-29.md SD5 — Lead exposure investigation, air quality, climate health, environmental disease._ 6 Health Access, FQHCs & SDOH _To be drafted from uploads/D2_pubHealth_verified_2026-04-29.md SD6 — FQHC architecture, healthcare access, social determinants of health._ 7 Substance Use & Harm Reduction _To be drafted from uploads/D2_pubHealth_verified_2026-04-29.md SD7 — Opioid response, harm-reduction infrastructure, behavioral-health interface._
